The regulatory liability recorded in October 2015 was $107 million, while the tax liability (deferred tax asset and resulting net increase in tax basis) was approximately $334 million.  
Ratio = 107 million ÷ 334 million ≈ 0.32.  

**Final value:** 0.32 (rounded to two decimals)【D0_C0】【D192_C4】
